other_conditions: Applicant must have qualified SSLC (Secondary School Leaving Certificate)
Applicant must be a permanent resident of Karnataka
Applicant must belong to the SC community
Applicant will be selected based on merit, must undergo district‑level screening and obtain franchisor approval
Beneficiary must compulsorily undergo the orientation program conducted by the franchisor
If the selected candidate is found ineligible at any stage, the sanction will be cancelled
For franchisor empanelment, the company must be registered in India
The company must provide a franchise/dealership opportunity
The company must have a strong brand and market presence for at least three years
The company must have a minimum of ten franchisees/dealerships
The company must provide marketing training to the entrepreneurs
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹10 lakh initial capital along with training, mentorship and capacity‑building support to the selected entrepreneur.
